results.text: Rosuvastatin safety: An experimental study of myotoxic effects and mitochondrial alterations in rats. Myopathy is the most commonly reported adverse effect of statins. All statins are associated with myopathy, though with different rates. Rosuvastatin is a potent statin reported to induce myopathy comparable to earlier statins. Risk of Hematuria, Proteinuria, and Cardiovascular Events in Patients Treated with Rosuvastatin Compared with Atorvastatin: A Retrospective Cohort Study in 136,680 Patients. Rosuvastatin and atorvastatin are the two primary high-intensity statins used for cardiovascular risk reduction. However, concerns have been raised regarding the renal safety profile of rosuvastatin.
